## Where the ideas come from

What the design owes to each framework reviewed in [approaches](approaches/README.md), area by area: each row adds to 100%, **New** is what no framework did first, and **Other** is frameworks without a review here. Hover over a cell for what was taken; [influences](approaches/influences.qmd) has the overall shares and how the numbers were made.

::: {.column-page}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import sciris as sc
influences = sc.importbypath('approaches/influences.py')
print(influences.heatmap(folder='approaches/'))
```
:::

## Does it pass its own test?

Each translation is held to two numbers from its original: no more lines of model code, and no more compute time. This is where each model stands; the model names link to the side-by-side comparison.

::: {.scorecard}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import sciris as sc
build = sc.importbypath('webapp/build.py')
print(build.scorecard())
```
:::
